channel.description: Telegram Gifts and Stars: how to sell, upgrade and manage them, step by step, with sources.

item.title: Telegram channels: what they are and how to use them
item.description: A Telegram channel is a one-way feed: admins post, subscribers read, with no subscriber limit. How to find, join, mute, leave and start one.

item.title: Telegram NFT gifts: are Telegram gifts NFTs?
item.description: Regular Telegram gifts are not NFTs. Upgraded collectibles can become NFTs on TON once moved to the blockchain, using your 2FA password and a Fragment page.

item.title: How to convert Telegram gifts to Stars, step by step
item.description: Open the gift you received, choose to convert it and confirm: the gift is destroyed and Stars go to your balance. It works only within 7 days of receiving it.

item.title: What are Telegram Stars and what are they used for?
item.description: Telegram Stars are virtual items for paying for digital goods inside Telegram: gifts, bots, mini apps, paid posts and subscriptions. You buy them in the app.

item.title: What are Telegram gifts and what are they for?
item.description: Telegram gifts are animated items bought with Stars and sent to people or channels. Recipients show them, convert them to Stars or upgrade them.

item.title: How to hide Telegram gifts on your profile
item.description: Hide one gift from My Profile, Gifts by tapping it and choosing to hide it. To stop new gifts showing up, use Settings, Privacy & Security, Gifts.

item.title: How to upgrade a Telegram gift to a collectible
item.description: Open the gift under Gifts on your profile and pay the upgrade price in Stars, or upgrade free if the sender prepaid. Not every gift can be upgraded.

item.title: How to sell a Telegram gift: collectible or regular
item.description: Only collectible (upgraded) gifts can be listed: open the gift, tap Sell, set a price in Stars. A regular gift can only be turned into Stars, within 7 days.

item.title: Telegram stickers: kinds, adding, making, removing
item.description: Telegram stickers are static images, Lottie animations or short WEBM videos, grouped in free sets. How to add a set, make your own and remove one.
